Te Wānanga o Raukawa is thrilled to once again host the highly anticipated preseason tournament! Since 2017, we've been bringing together the country's top teams for a weekend of intense competition, and this year promises to be bigger and better than ever.  
   
Join us as we welcome some of the best netball teams from around New Zealand:  
   
The VIP Tactix (Christchurch) 
AVIS Waikato Bay of Plenty Magic (Hamilton)  
Northern Mystics (Auckland)  
Ascot Park Hotel Southern Steel (Invercargill)  
Te Wānanga o Raukawa Pulse (Wellington)  
   
But that's not all! This year, we're excited to add an extra special opening match to the schedule: the Te Wānanga o Raukawa Pulse will take on the Pulse Men's team in a thrilling showdown.  
   
At Te Wānanga o Raukawa, we're all about whakawhanaungatanga (relationship building) and fostering a sense of community. Our marae-style hospitality will make our visiting teams feel right at home, with plenty of opportunities to bond with their opponents and enjoy some friendly rivalry.  
   
Want to stay up-to-date on the tournament action or purchase tickets? Head to https://www.wananga.com/pre-season-netball-tournament-2025   for all the latest info!
